note: Fluent TUI error diagnostics from the log. The codes are used in reports (analysis.findings[].code). Maintained from report files sent by colleagues.

patterns.meaning: After /file/write-case-data "..." yes the file is already written, and the trailing yes token is rejected because overwrite confirmations are enabled in batch mode.
patterns.recommendation: Consider the setup successful if .cas.h5/.dat.h5 exist. If desired, drop the trailing yes or set /file/confirm-overwrite? no before saving.

patterns.match: An error or interrupt occurred while reading the journal file
patterns.meaning: The journal was aborted: Fluent stopped executing lines after an error, the rest of the file was not run.
patterns.recommendation: Find the first error above in the log, fix it and restart from the beginning. Split the journal into stages.

patterns.meaning: The command is unavailable in the current configuration (no mesh/case, model not enabled, different menu state) or the syntax does not match the Fluent version.
patterns.recommendation: Check the journal step order and the session state; for pre-2026 versions check the legacy command paths.

patterns.meaning: A boolean TUI question received an invalid answer.
patterns.recommendation: Use yes/no (not y/n) in the journal; cross-check the question chain in data/recipes.

patterns.meaning: The zone name/ID was not found in the current mesh — the journal expects different zone names.
patterns.recommendation: Capture the actual names: /define/boundary-conditions/list-zones and /mesh/modify-zones list-zones; update the profile/template.

patterns.meaning: Problem with the ANSYS license server.
patterns.recommendation: Check: ss -ltn | grep 1055; systemctl --user status ansyslmd; lmutil lmstat -a -c <server>; the ANSYSLMD_LICENSE_FILE variable.

patterns.meaning: Failed to compile/load the UDF library.
patterns.recommendation: Check that the compiler and Fluent headers are available, the paths to the .c files, and the permissions on the libudf directory; build manually in the TUI.

patterns.match: (?i)(cannot read|unable to read|failed to read|file does not exist|no such file)
patterns.meaning: A file (mesh, .cas, UDF, TSV, journal) was not found or cannot be read. Check the paths relative to the Fluent working directory.
patterns.recommendation: Journal paths are relative to the Fluent launch directory; check that the files exist and the case of the names.

patterns.meaning: A Scheme expression error in the journal; the journal aborts after it.
patterns.recommendation: Check the lines in parentheses, the absence of extra tokens and the availability of RP variables; one form per line.

patterns.meaning: Abnormal termination of the Fluent process.
patterns.recommendation: Check the log/transcript, reproduce on a smaller case, attach the .trn to the report to the maintainer.

patterns.meaning: Not enough memory for the mesh/run.
patterns.recommendation: Reduce the number of processes/mesh size, check /mesh/memory-usage and /parallel; take the license limit into account.

patterns.meaning: Overwrite confirmations are enabled in batch mode.
patterns.recommendation: For reproducible runs set /file/confirm-overwrite? no or do not pass an extra yes.

patterns.meaning: A journal answer did not match the current TUI prompt (the dialog has more or fewer questions in this case state); the token was parsed as a Scheme expression.
patterns.recommendation: Check the prompt chain for this case state. For reacting mixtures, change-create asks Reaction and Mechanism before Density (+2 'no'). Run the command interactively once and record the exact chain, then use the matching recipe (materials.mixture-density-method[.reacting]).

patterns.meaning: The TUI expected an integer but received a different token, usually because the journal answers are shifted by one relative to the prompt chain.
patterns.recommendation: Align the journal with the actual dialogs (see dialog-misalignment); for reacting mixtures the mixture property chain includes Reaction and Mechanism prompts.
